content.title: Continuous Retreat Scale Reveal | Moving Anchor and Expanding Hazard
content.summary: Establish one small moving carrier with a readable heading, speed cue and trail, then reveal an environmental hazard through one uninterrupted camera ascent and retreat. Keep the carrier and anomaly in the same coordinate relationship as the anomaly changes from ambiguous texture into a dominant coherent threat, and hold before impact while the carrier remains readable.

quick_start.input_format: small moving carrier with readable direction, speed and trail + uninterrupted camera ascent and retreat with no reveal cut + carrier and anomaly remain in one coordinate relationship + ambiguous feature grows into a coherent hazard occupying most of the frame + pre-impact threshold hold with the carrier still visible
quick_start.recommended_input: A small orange maintenance tram crosses a silver orbital mirror field and leaves a thin blue inspection-light trail. One continuous aerial retreat turns a weak circular reflection mismatch into a vast eclipse aperture, then holds with the tram still outside the inner dark rim.
required_anchors: Establish one small moving carrier with heading, speed cue and trail before the anomaly is legible.
Use one uninterrupted camera retreat and elevation change with no reveal cut.
Grow the anomaly from ambiguous texture into a coherent hazard occupying more of the frame.
Hold before impact or disappearance with the carrier still readable.
usage_steps: Replace the example subject, setting, and surface details with an original concept.

Choose the MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 prompt and fill only the declared variable slots.
Check duration, event order, camera continuity, sound, and anti-copy constraints before generation.
applicable_scope: Establish one small moving carrier with a readable heading, speed cue and trail, then reveal an environmental hazard through one uninterrupted camera ascent and retreat. creative_dna.mechanism: Establish one original small moving carrier with a readable heading, speed cue and trail before an environmental anomaly is legible. Use one continuous camera retreat and elevation change with no reveal cut, keeping the carrier and anomaly in the same coordinate relationship as more environment enters the frame. Let the anomaly evolve from an ambiguous dark or geometric texture into a coherent hazard that occupies progressively more of the composition, while the carrier remains the stable scale unit. End on a held pre-impact or threshold state before the carrier disappears. The reusable mechanism is moving scale anchor, uninterrupted context expansion, ambiguity-to-hazard reveal and critical-distance hold—not the source wooden ship, sail, ocean, whirlpool, Odyssey claim, exact camera path, water physics, palette, watermark, creator identity or timing.

invariants.rule: Establish one small moving carrier with heading, speed cue and trail before the anomaly is legible.
invariants.purpose: Provides a stable comparison unit for every later scale reveal.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without a moving anchor, the hazard's size and distance remain abstract.

invariants.rule: Use one uninterrupted camera retreat and elevation change with no reveal cut.
invariants.purpose: Lets scale emerge from added context rather than editorial substitution.
invariants.ablation_failure: A cut can fake scale and break the promised continuous observation.

invariants.rule: Keep carrier and anomaly in one coordinate relationship as the frame expands.
invariants.purpose: Makes approach distance and danger continuously measurable.
invariants.ablation_failure: Reframing them independently removes spatial causality.

invariants.rule: Grow the anomaly from ambiguous texture into a coherent hazard occupying more of the frame.
invariants.purpose: Turns curiosity into threat through visual evidence alone.
invariants.ablation_failure: Showing the full hazard immediately removes the escalation.

invariants.rule: Hold before impact or disappearance with the carrier still readable.
invariants.purpose: Preserves the final scale comparison and avoids replacing tension with destruction.
invariants.ablation_failure: Losing the carrier prevents verification of the critical distance.

anti_copy_exclusions: the source wooden single-mast ship, sail, hull, wake and exact heading
the source ocean surface, sunlight, circular whirlpool, water depression, rim and flow physics
the source Odyssey premise, maritime iconography, implied voyage and threat meaning
the source aerial rear retreat, altitude curve, framing, timing and cinematic color treatment
the source creator identity, Yapper AI and Seedance 2.5 marks, watermark, text and branding
